## Rules

- Exact protocol scenarios are §4. Use synthetic keys and local receiver only. Bulk client accepts partial completion and opaque result URLs. Webhook signs/verifies exact bytes, deduplicates on delivery identity and never infers a Laravel class from topic.

## Guidance

Run clients as separate processes against an installed candidate app. Control time with the test clock. Corrupt one signature byte and replay one delivery id; prove no client side effect before/after rejection respectively.

## Intent

## Scope Included

Bulk submit/poll/result/cancel/partial-failure client; webhook subscribe/signature/dedupe/replay client; published snapshots; local receiver; tamper/duplicate/expiry negatives.

## Scope Excluded

Live external sends; production secrets; unbounded workload; GraphQL; new topic; provider code imports.

## Required Reads

1) `@plan/phases/P17/phase.json`; 2) `@plan/knowledge/research-P17-design.json` §0, §4; 3) `@plan/phases/P17/P17.1.json`; 4) `@plan/phases/P14/P14.18.json`; 5) `@plan/phases/P14/P14.20.json`; 6) `@plan/knowledge/research-P14-design.json` §4–§10, §13–§14; 7) `@plan/decisions/D80.json`; 8) `@plan/decisions/D84.json`.

## Implementation Rules

Exact protocol scenarios are §4. Use synthetic keys and local receiver only. Bulk client accepts partial completion and opaque result URLs. Webhook signs/verifies exact bytes, deduplicates on delivery identity and never infers a Laravel class from topic.

## Code Guidance

Run clients as separate processes against an installed candidate app. Control time with the test clock. Corrupt one signature byte and replay one delivery id; prove no client side effect before/after rejection respectively.

## Validation

Full bulk lifecycle and one row failure pass; cancellation preserves completed effects. Webhook exact signature passes, tamper fails, duplicate is idempotent and bounded replay obeys retention. Snapshot mismatch and undeclared topic fail before action.
